diagnosis: Repeated SQLite preparation and connection reopening remain in the new indexed write path; profile attributes 16.4% of sampled CPU to prepareV2 and 22.3% to record writes, while indexed reference reads consume 2.4%.
bounded_repair: Reuse prepared record upsert, reference delete, and reference insert statements through each SQL transaction.
Retain eight idle connections to match the existing maximum of eight open connections.
expected_proof: The unchanged 10000-row IPC capture scenario exceeds 2000 rows/s, followed by full core sim and the required gates.
residual_uncertainty: Shared Air contention affects absolute timings; prepared-statement reuse must be verified before treating it as sufficient.
bounded_repair_outcome: Prepared-statement/idle-pool experiment did not demonstrate a benefit under load and was reverted; no general State write cache is included.
acceptance_update: Leader requires interleaved loaded A/B with three samples each, new-code scaling at 2000/10000/20000 rows, and pending-quiet for an unmet absolute target.
